scope.summary: Scaffold the BodyKit kernel module per Section 13.16 (BK-16.1 scope/submodule framing): create src/tailor/bodykit/ with mod.rs, a typed BodyKitError enum, and event/schema constants (EVENT_FAMILY_TAILOR_BODY = "tailor.body" matching the 13.14 registered constant, SCHEMA_TAILOR_BODY_SPEC_V1 = "hsk.tailor.body_spec@1"), plus the solver-side tailor-solver/src/body/ module skeleton. Kernel authority/orchestration code lives in bodykit/; ALL geometry/solver body code lives in tailor-solver/src/body/ — this split is the architectural law every later BodyKit MT builds on.
acceptance_criteria: src/tailor/bodykit/mod.rs compiles and is re-exported from src/tailor/mod.rs; tailor-solver/src/body/mod.rs compiles and is re-exported from the tailor-solver crate root.

BodyKitError enum exists with at least variants Validation, Storage, LicenseRejected, TopologyContract and implements std::error::Error + Display; kernel-side BodyKit functions return Result<_, BodyKitError>.
Constant EVENT_FAMILY_TAILOR_BODY = "tailor.body" is defined once in bodykit and a test asserts it equals the TAILOR_BODY event-family constant registered in the 13.14 canonical list.
SCHEMA_TAILOR_BODY_SPEC_V1 = "hsk.tailor.body_spec@1" is defined in src/tailor/schemas.rs alongside the existing SCHEMA_TAILOR_* constants.
No mesh/vertex/delta geometry types appear in src/tailor/bodykit/; the module doc records the kernel-vs-solver split rule.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the scaffold and the kernel/solver split declared up front, later BodyKit MTs smear geometry code into the authority layer, recreating the tangled monolith that makes Daz's morph system unauditable and unfixable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
